a.lede: The app connects to Instagram to build a virtual closet from photos you’ve already shared, or lets you add items manually by snapping a photo, recording a quick video, or uploading images from your camera roll.
a.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app called Style Sketch

b.lede: Meta has launched an AI fashion app called Style Sketch in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand.
b.title: Meta quietly launches an AI fashion app for virtually trying on clothes
